pr_title: Automatically add entry title as name placeholder in reauth
pr_body:
<!--

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->

When an integration support multiple entries and reauth, it isn't always clear which config entry needs reauth (as reported in #64007).

This PR adjusts the triggering of the reauth flow a tiny bit, by setting the entry title in the context of the flow. This way a user can see which config entry the re-auth is about.

issue_context.title: SimpliSafe account reconfiguration doesn't specify which account it is for
issue_context.body:
### The problem

When an account needs to be re-authenticated there is no indication which account (email address or userId) it is that needs to be re-authenticated. This is not an issue for most people since most people only have one account but people with multiple accounts are forced to guess and check to see which login works. Would it be possible to add the email address or the userId into the reconfiguration prompt?

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.12.7

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

SimpliSafe

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/simplisafe/
